r: Appointed **Dictator for Andhra** by the **Andhra Congress Committee** to conduct the **Salt Satyagraha / CDM** – the first CDM leader in Andhra
Had met Gandhi with an Andhra team; "Father of the Andhra State Movement"
**Each district had its own dictator, a war council and a military-style camp (sibiram)** – idea credited to **Pattabhi Sitaramayya**
**Madras** – centre of Salt Satyagraha activity in Madras
**Making salt, cutting toddy palms, picketing toddy and arrack shops, raiding salt depots**

0.x: District salt marches in East and West Godavari, Krishna and Guntur; merchants funded the Congress, but mass support on the NCM scale was missing.
Later echo: the women's anti-arrack agitation at **Dubagunta (Nellore), 1991**.

r: Circle inspector **Mustafa Ali** brutally attacked the satyagrahis of the **Seethanagaram (Sita) Ashram**
**Prativadi Bhayankarachari** threw a bomb at him at Kakinada (it failed)
Founder of the revolutionary "**Ujjivana Bharata Samithi / Sammelan**" in the **Godavari district**
**14 years**; sent to the **Andaman Cellular Jail**
Viceroy of the Dandi March (1930) and the Pact (1931)
First Independence Day; Thota Narsayya's flag at Machilipatnam
Salt law broken at Dandi; first Andhra salt satyagraha, Machilipatnam
Of **Krishna district** – the **only Telugu** among the **78** Dandi marchers; later founded an ashram at **Komaravolu**
**K. Nageswara Rao**, V.L. Sastry, **Durgabai Deshmukh**, Gade Rangayya Naidu, **T. Prakasam**
Led about **20 women** to make salt at the High Court beach
First woman graduate in Andhra; **first woman jailed in the Salt Satyagraha** – at **Vedaranyam** (after Rajaji's arrest)
First woman arrested in the salt satyagraha in Andhra
"Swarajya Lakshmi Vratam" door to door on Ugadi, Guntur

2.x: Andhra women joined in **large numbers** – salt-making, picketing, imprisonment.

r: **Tripuraneni Ramaswamy Chowdary** – composed during the **Salt Satyagraha / CDM**
**Ayyadevara Kaleswara Rao** (first salt satyagraha), Mutnuri Krishna Rao, **Pattabhi Sitaramayya** ("my Mecca")
Bomma Seshareddy, **Bezawada Gopala Reddy** (made salt **11 April 1930**), **Oruganti Venkatasubbayya**
**T. Prakasam** with **Kasinathuni Nageswara Rao** – first salt squad; Durgabai also broke the law
Hoisted the flag on **26 Jan 1930**; injured raising it at **Tilak Chowk**
